name: Adam Data Centre
notes: Adam Internet page describes an operational secure colocation data centre outside the Adelaide CBD and says Adam stopped taking new Adam-branded data-centre customers in 2024; iTnews reported the Mile End facility opening in 2009 with 200 stage-one racks; Inflect places Adam Internet ADC at 19-47 London Road, Mile End South, within West Torrens.

name: Whyalla Regional Data Centre
notes: INTREC project page says it was engaged to design and construct a 5MW regional data centre in SA for Ashur Digital Labs; local Whyalla council coverage also references a solar-powered digital mining/data-centre investment in Whyalla. Commissioning/operational status not clearly stated in public source.

name: VIRIDIS Burnie Data Centre
notes: VIRIDIS says Burnie City Council approved a permit for Storage Use (Data Centre) in the Burnie CBD, with target go-live in the first half of 2027 and approximately 1MW grid draw. DCD reported the approval on 2026-04-09.
